# Must-survive regression corpus (#1371 / #1159 AC4).
#
# Every line below is a durable belief that the write-side admission
# filter used to delete. `is_transcript_noise` returned True for all of
# them before #1371: the ack regex `^(Yes|No|Standing by|Ready|Nothing|
# Polling)( .{0,40})?\.?$` swallowed any clause opening on one of six
# words, and `_TRANSCRIPT_SHELL_PREFIXES` was matched with a bare
# `startswith`, so any sentence beginning with a command name went too.
#
# Rules for this file:
#   * one statement per line; blank lines and `#` comments ignored
#   * a line here is an assertion that `is_transcript_noise` returns
#     False for it — nothing else
#   * add a row whenever a real statement is found to have been dropped;
#     never delete a row to make a filter change pass
#
# The complementary corpus — utterances that must STILL be filtered —
# lives in tests/test_noise_filter.py, so a narrowing change cannot
# quietly gut the categories.

# --- ack keywords in belief position (the six-word prefix set) --------
No vector embeddings, ever.
No tests exist for the temporal spine.
No we should use uv instead of pip.
Nothing in retrieval may call the network.
Ready means the gate passed.
Yes is not a valid value for the lock column.
Standing by is what the monitor prints when idle.
Polling the API costs one request per turn.

# --- shell command names in belief position --------------------------
git history rewrite is denied by the ruleset.
pytest is the only test runner we support.
gh api is the only way to delete refs.
python 3.13 is the minimum supported version.
uv run is the required invocation for every script.
cd /tmp is not a portable assumption on Windows.

# --- guard rows: longer prose that escaped the old regexes only by
# --- exceeding their 40-char tail budget. Not red before #1371; here so
# --- a future widening of that budget goes red instead of shipping.
Nothing in the hook path may import the numeric stack.
No belief is ever hard-deleted by the review flow.
Ready state for the merge train means the bot check is green.
